game.name: Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut
game.rules:
**General Rules for all versions**

- Using macros or turbo controllers for your inputs in any way whatsoever is banned.

- No cheats of any kind, unofficial versions, or texture hacks are allowed.

**PC Disc/Steam rules**

- Runs are timed by IGT (In-game Time), you must show it during the whole run. This is NOT the save file timer, if you do not know how to configure Livesplit to show IGT and RTA times please use the following guide: http://www.speedrun.com/sadx/guide/aryzs

- Runs slower than the threshold for video proof (where applicable) does not require RTA time submitted but it is encouraged.

- Enhancements or UI Scaling Graphics within SADX Mod Manager are allowed. There are many versions of the Mod Manager used by runners, but in general "Force Texture Filtering", "Force Mipmapping", and any UI Scaling settings are allowed.

- Patches in the SADX Mod Manager are allowed (found in newer versions)

- The following mods are approved: Xinput fix / Input Mod, CCEF (Camera Code Error Fix), EHCF (Egg Hornet Crash Fix), 63/60 fps limiters, SADX Speedrun Mod.

- Replacing or removing music files is allowed.

- Removing voice files is allowed.

- Swapping voice files between languages is not allowed. (so, not some in English and some in Japanese)

- Swapping voice files with another file is not allowed.

- Setting the game to play at 30/15 FPS is banned (Frame Rate setting)

**Console Rules (XBLA/PSN/GC)**

- Please submit RTA without milliseconds.

**XBLA Rules**

- All runs faster than the "LOADLESS THRESHOLD" will be retimed without cutscenes and loads by the moderators.

**PSN Rules**

- Runs are only timed by RTA. Loadless timers can be used for the purposes of pace-keeping.

**Gamecube Rules**

- Runs are only timed by RTA.

- Emulators are banned.

- USB Loading is banned (through Nintendont, DIOS MIOS, etc.).

- Using USB Loading software to load a SADX disc is banned.

newsList.title: Separation of XBLA and PSN
newsList.body:
Hi all, just an update on the console boards...

XBLA and PSN have been separated into different sub-categories. While this may stifle competition in the console boards overall, it should make things more fair.

I have manually retimed all of the XBLA runs above a certain time threshold without cuts

relatedGames.rules:
##General Rules:
• All runs require video proof for verification. Any video with too many attempts before the actual run start will be rejected.

• No cheats of any kind, unofficial versions, or texture hacks are allowed. 

##PC Disc/Steam-specific rules :

• Runs are timed by IGT (In-game Time), you must show the timer during the whole run. This is NOT the save file timer, if you do not know how to configure Livesplit to show IGT and RTA times please use the following guide: http://www.speedrun.com/sadx/guide/aryzs

• The following mods are approved: **Xinput fix / Input Mod, EHCF, CCEF, 63/60 fps mod, quick save reload module of the Speedrun mod.** For more information about the mods, please check the guide:  https://www.speedrun.com/sadx/thread/cuep6

• Removing voice files or replacing music files is allowed. However, editing voices files is not allowed as they impact in the game directly.

##Consoles-Specific rules :

• Runs are only timed by RTA (Real Time Attack.) **So leave the IGT field empty.**

• Emulators are banned.

• Third party controllers are banned.

categories.name: Sonic's Story
categories.rules:
## General Rules

From a clean (0%) save file, complete Sonic's Story.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the In-Game Timer for Egg Viper stops. It is preferable to play up until after the results screen to ensure the run is complete.

All Runs under 50 minutes require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when Egg Viper is complete.

All runs under 50 minutes RTA require video proof as well as IGT.

### Route variations:

- **Linear route**: Intended level order.
- **TAS route**: Entering Casinopolis after Emerald Coast.
- **Glitched route**: Utilizing Trial Mode Glitch to complete stages out of order, most common example is entering Speed Highway Early.

categories.name: Tails' Story
categories.rules:
## General Rules

From a save file that has unlocked Tails's Story which is at 0% completion, complete Tails's Story.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the In-Game Timer for Egg Walker stops. It is preferable to play up until after the results screen to ensure the run is complete.

All Runs under 30 minutes require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when Egg Walker is complete.

All runs under 30 minutes RTA require video proof as well as IGT.

### Route variations:

- **Linear route**: Intended level order.
- **Early Ice Cap**: Entering Ice Cap before it’s intended place in the story.

categories.name: All Stories
categories.rules:
## General Rules

Complete all the stories from a clean save file (Sonic 0%, no other characters unlocked).

You may soft reset the game in-between stories, watching the credits is not required.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the In-Game Timer for Perfect Chaos stops. It is preferable to play up until after the results screen to ensure the run is complete.

All Runs require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when Perfect Chaos is complete.

All runs require video proof as well as IGT.

## XBLA Specific Rules

All Stories is timed entirely by RTA for the XBLA version. If there is a sufficient level of competition in the category, it can be timed by loadless.

categories.name: 130 Emblems
categories.rules:
## General Rules

Collect all 130 emblems from a clean save file (Sonic 0%, no other characters unlocked) and a new Chao file.

You are required to train a brand new Chao from an egg to gain the stats needed for your Chao races as part of the same run. IE New Run = New Chao from Egg for races.

From runs performed on 2022-02-04 onwards, ''Fusion's Chao Editor'' is banned for speedrunning purposes. The SADX Speedrun Mod (v.1.2.2 and onwards), will replace it with a Stat Viewer function. For more information, feel free to ask a moderator of the game.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the emblem counter changes to 130.

All Runs require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when 130 Emblems are collected.

All runs require video proof as well as IGT.

## XBLA-Specific Rules

All runs are timed by RTA unless sufficient competition in the category warrants a loadless retime.

## Gamecube-Specific Rules:

Tiny Chao Garden is not allowed. Do NOT use Tiny Chao Garden to restore, move, or otherwise train a Chao from outside SADX

categories.name: Individual Level
categories.rules: If applicable, raw footage of the run (without pause buffers omitted) is required for submission. The raw footage does not have to be the main video of the submission and can be linked in the run’s description.

levels.name: Emerald Coast
levels.rules:
Complete the stage as fast as possible, you can finish it in Adventure mode or Trial mode. 

• Leaderboard is ranked by IGT only, so leave the RTA field empty. 

• The time displayed in-game during the result screen is your final time. 

• All runs require video proof for verification.

• Using a character not originally made for this stage is not allowed.
 
No cheats of any kind, unofficial versions, emulators, or texture hacks are allowed for these runs. You may use the infinite lives cheat from the ModManager in individual level runs ONLY. The emblem glitch and the following mods are approved: Xinput fix / Input Mod, CCEF, 63/60 fps mod. Removing voice files or replacing music files is also allowed. However, editing voices files is not allowed as they impact in the game directly.

Hey, how's it going. Long time no see! I'm back, and this time I decided to switch to TAS variation because it seems like a good option with its fair share of benefits.

The beginning of my run was awesome. Basically everything through Sky Chase I have no complaints about besides general minor improvements (better hub movement etc.).

Twinkle Park, I could have done better after the coaster skip. Speed Highway, I missed the platform at the beginning costing me a few seconds. I died at the beginning of Red Mountain costing me about 15-20 seconds. Sky Deck I'll talk about later. Chaos 6 was good. Lost World I was starting to choke. And Final Egg was fine.

OK, there are some oddities in my game, it might be my computer but some things were just wrong. Like the wierd gear mechanism outside of Tails' workshop just isn't visibly there, but the hitbox is. Tails wasn't with me in Sky Deck for some reason. 

Speaking of Sky Deck, I thought this only happened in the steam/betterSADX version where the canon kills you at the end of act 1. That's been happening for me for a while, and I've done exstensive testing with it. I've tested it on other computers in my house with the exact same installation of the game running on a usb drive (never do that, it sucks =P), and it only happens on my computer. It just makes me sad that if I had waited just half a second, then I would be sitting with a sub 35.

Overall, I'm definitely proud of this run, and I will be working on improving on it soon!

Oh, sorry about the noise at the end, the streamer I had paused ended their stream around then and hosted somebody.

categories.name: Tails' Story
categories.rules:
## General Rules

From a save file that has unlocked Tails's Story which is at 0% completion, complete Tails's Story.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the In-Game Timer for Egg Walker stops. It is preferable to play up until after the results screen to ensure the run is complete.

All Runs under 30 minutes require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when Egg Walker is complete.

All runs under 30 minutes RTA require video proof as well as IGT.

### Route variations:

- **Linear route**: Intended level order.
- **Early Ice Cap**: Entering Ice Cap before it’s intended place in the story.

categories.name: Knuckles' Story
categories.rules:
## General Rules

From a save file that has unlocked Knuckles's Story which is at 0% completion, complete Knuckles's Story.

RTA time begins on the first black frame after the fadeout of the character select/instructions screen.

The timer stops when the In-Game Timer for Chaos 6 stops. It is preferable to play up until after the results screen to ensure the run is complete.

All Runs under 20 minutes require video proof.

## PC Disk/Steam Specific Rules

The IGT timer for PC Disk/Steam version will begin the run for you after the character is selected. It will also split when Chaos 6 is complete.

All runs under 20 minutes RTA require video proof as well as IGT.

games.name: Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut
games.rules:
**General Rules for all versions**

- Using macros or turbo controllers for your inputs in any way whatsoever is banned.

- No cheats of any kind, unofficial versions, or texture hacks are allowed.

**PC Disc/Steam rules**

- Runs are timed by IGT (In-game Time), you must show it during the whole run. This is NOT the save file timer, if you do not know how to configure Livesplit to show IGT and RTA times please use the following guide: http://www.speedrun.com/sadx/guide/aryzs

- Runs slower than the threshold for video proof (where applicable) does not require RTA time submitted but it is encouraged.

- Enhancements or UI Scaling Graphics within SADX Mod Manager are allowed. There are many versions of the Mod Manager used by runners, but in general "Force Texture Filtering", "Force Mipmapping", and any UI Scaling settings are allowed.

- Patches in the SADX Mod Manager are allowed (found in newer versions)

- The following mods are approved: Xinput fix / Input Mod, CCEF (Camera Code Error Fix), EHCF (Egg Hornet Crash Fix), 63/60 fps limiters, SADX Speedrun Mod.

- Replacing or removing music files is allowed.

- Removing voice files is allowed.

- Swapping voice files between languages is not allowed. (so, not some in English and some in Japanese)

- Swapping voice files with another file is not allowed.

- Setting the game to play at 30/15 FPS is banned (Frame Rate setting)

**Console Rules (XBLA/PSN/GC)**

- Please submit RTA without milliseconds.

**XBLA Rules**

- All runs faster than the "LOADLESS THRESHOLD" will be retimed without cutscenes and loads by the moderators.

**PSN Rules**

- Runs are only timed by RTA. Loadless timers can be used for the purposes of pace-keeping.

**Gamecube Rules**

- Runs are only timed by RTA.

- Emulators are banned.

- USB Loading is banned (through Nintendont, DIOS MIOS, etc.).

- Using USB Loading software to load a SADX disc is banned.
